summary:
Frontend-only regression for iteration 6 (spec-driven encounter flows for all 5 NTDs). Cleared localStorage 'trias.state.v1' and logged in as admin@trias.health. Ran 40+ Playwright assertions against public preview URL. Zero page errors, zero console errors, zero pageerror events. Coverage:
(1) All 5 disease encounter flows open without errors at /patients/P-2026-001001/encounter/<scabies|yaws|buruli|lf|leprosy>?fac=Bilbil%20Health%20Centre&vt=Follow-up. Each renders 9 collapsible sections (section-toggle-1..9) and the encounter-context line 'Disease · Facility · Follow-up · Referral No' with the correct disease name (Scabies / Yaws / Buruli Ulcer / Lymphatic Filariasis / Leprosy).
(2) Disease-specific content verified via testids: Yaws lab shows lab-rdt, lab-dfapcr, lab-darkfield; LF body chart exposes lesion-code-S1..S7 (7 stages); Buruli body chart exposes lesion-code-PA/PN/PPl/O/NU; Leprosy assessment section has assess-patches, assess-nerves plus 3 sensory ChoiceRows (hands/feet/eyes) and 5 VMT ChoiceRows (eye/wrist/finger/foot/thumb).
(3) Weight-based dose maths (Elijah 21kg) render EXACTLY as specced: Scabies 'Tab Ivermectin 4.2 mg · 1.5 tab(s) of 3mg'; LF 'Tab DEC 50mg 126.0 mg · 2.5 tab(s) of 50mg'; Buruli 'Tab Rifampicin 300mg 210.0 mg · 0.5 tab(s) of 300mg' and 'Tab Clarithromycin 500mg 157.5 mg · 0.5 tab(s) of 500mg'; Yaws 'Tab Azithromycin 500mg 630.0 mg · 1.5 tab(s) of 500mg'. Fixed-dose drugs (Benzathine penicillin, Albendazole) show their age-band text ('0.6 MU (<10y) / 1.2 MU (10y+)' etc.) instead of a computed dose.
(4) Leprosy auto-diagnosis: 7 patches + 3 nerves → 'Multibacillary (MB) (7 patches, 3 nerves)'; 2+1 → 'Paucibacillary (PB) (2 patches, 1 nerves)'; 0+0 → 'No Leprosy (0 patches, 0 nerves)'. All shown in auto-diagnosis panel above the diagnosis chooser (can be overridden).
(5) Leprosy auto-scoring: sensory 'Both' hands + feet and VMT 'Paralysed (2)' produced EHF=10 (capped at 12), WHO G2D=2 in leprosy-scores panel, and a red '🔴 WHO Grade 2 disability — EHF score 10 — refer for MMDP and self-care.' urgent alert (encounter-alert-urgent-*).
(6) Yaws auto-diagnosis: single Papilloma (P) lesion on chest → 'Primary Yaws' shown in auto-diagnosis. Logic for Secondary (multiple P/U) and Tertiary (BC lesion) is present in yawsClass() and matches spec — verified against source.
(7) Buruli adherence renders 8 dated weekly cells (adherence-0..adherence-7) with an adherence-extend button. Leprosy has adherence-restart in addition (cfg.restart=true). Cell states cycle taken→not taken→blank on click via the AdherenceGrid onClick.
(8) Household section renders groupCount grids per AGE_SEX_GROUPS (Male child <15y / Male adult 15y+ / Female child <15y / Female adult 15y+) with running total, one grid per prophylactic drug, and a contact register (contactTable) with per-row testids for name/age/sex/rel/status/consent/prophylaxis and remove-<i>.
(9) Patient list cards (patient-card-<id>) show the exact meta line 'P-2026-00100X · Dx <diagnosis> · Last encounter <dd-MMM-yyyy or —> · <New|Draft|Complete>'. Elijah shows 'Dx Confirmed scabies · Last encounter 09-Jun-2026 · Draft' (his latest encounter status is 'Draft' in seed data — see minor note below). Grace/Lucy/Samuel/Rita all show 'New' (no encounters yet). DOB rendered as dd-MMM-yyyy on every card.
(10) Suspect screen loads the new 31-item symptom list (symptom-* testids count = 31) and 7 suspect-* option buttons (scabies, yaws, buruli, lf, leprosy, other, none). Page renders without errors.
(11) Patient record: record-tabs contains tab-all, tab-suspect, plus one tab per condition on the patient (tab-scabies for Elijah). LHS panel (lhs-panel) shows photo, name, ID, DOB (dd-MMM-yyyy), Age, Sex, Blood, Weight, Phone, Village, Province, Consent and a clinical-summary card. lhs-collapse-btn hides the panel and lhs-expand-btn restores it. add-encounter-btn opens add-encounter-dialog with facility/date/visit-type/referral/target selects; encounter-start starts the flow.
(12) Admin → Masters → Regiment (master-tab-regiment) lists 6 seeded regimens in regimen-table with new-regimen-* inputs (name/disease/diagnosis/drug/age min/max/weight min/max), add-regimen-btn and remove-regimen-<id> per row.
(13) MIS Dashboard: mis-filter-panel is not in the DOM until mis-filter-toggle-btn is clicked. filter-clinician is present. Selecting filter-period 'Custom' reveals filter-from and filter-to date inputs. mis-view-toggle-btn swaps the episodes-by-month AreaChart for mis-trend-table.
(14) 390x844 responsiveness: documentElement.scrollWidth === 390 on /patients, /patients/:id and /patients/:id/encounter/scabies (no page-level horizontal overflow). Encounter body-chart region grid, adherence grid, and contact register scroll horizontally inside their own cards as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: Fields.jsx ChoiceRow/CheckGrid slug: `${testid}-${o.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')}` does NOT trim leading/trailing hyphens, so 'Paralysed (2)' → testid 'assess-vmteye-paralysed-2-' with a TRAILING DASH. Cosmetic but unusual — align with the FormRenderer's slug() helper which strips leading/trailing hyphens for consistency.

FormRenderer slug lowercases before splitting on non-alnum, so camelCase field keys merge into one word: itchNight → 'hist-itchnight', sensoryHands → 'assess-sensoryhands', dfaPcr → 'lab-dfapcr'. That works but is easy to trip over when writing tests (agent-to-agent note in review_request used the hyphenated form). Consider a slug that inserts a hyphen at camelCase boundaries (e.g. /([a-z])([A-Z])/g → '$1-$2') so testids read 'hist-itch-night', 'assess-sensory-hands'. Purely quality-of-life.

Fields.jsx ChoiceRow container has NO data-testid — only the individual option buttons carry testids. Adding `data-testid={testid}` to the wrapper (or a `-group` suffix) would make it possible to assert 'the question is rendered' without knowing option values. Currently visible field vs. hidden-by-when is not testable via a single selector.

PatientRecord.jsx: default new-encounter dialog `enc.disease` is empty, so the 'Go to' Select displays 'Suspect screening' — correct. But `SPEC_LIST.find((s) => s.name === v)?.id || ''` silently maps 'Suspect screening' to '' and any typo to ''. Consider an explicit ['suspect', 'Suspect screening'] option to avoid ambiguity.

Encounter.jsx `outcome` variable auto-overrides d.outcome when diagnosis starts with 'No ', but the underlying state d.outcome is not synced — if the user then changes the diagnosis back to a positive value, the previously auto-picked 'No X' outcome is lost from the UI (falls back to d.outcome which is still 'Open'). Consider persisting the auto-outcome into state on diagnosis change.

leprosyScores: eyes uses side(sensoryEyes)+vmt(vmtEye) but hands double-counts if the tester selects vmtThumb alongside vmtFinger — 3 VMT values all count in hands, so max hands raw = 2 (side) + 6 (three VMTs) = 8. This is capped at 4 for EHF (correct per WHO), but the raw 'Eyes / Hands / Feet' chip displays uncapped values (e.g. '2 / 8 / 4'). Consider labeling the chip 'raw disability points' or showing both raw and capped to avoid clinician confusion.

Elijah's seeded encounter status renders as 'Draft' on the patient card, not the 'Complete-ish' the review_request expected. Root cause: seeded encounters don't have status:'Complete' — cards fallback to 'Draft'. Not a bug, just a seed-data mismatch with the described scenario. Consider updating the seed encounter for Elijah to status:'Complete' so the card shows the intended demo state.
PatientHeader still renders <dt>/<dd> pairs inside a <div>, which is invalid HTML (dt/dd must be direct children of <dl>). Carried over from iter-5, still not fixed.
store.addUser/addFacility/saveEncounter id generation via Date.now()/Math.random() (carried over from iter-4 & iter-5). Still not fixed; on rapid double-clicks a duplicate id is possible.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Testid slug rules (important):
- FormRenderer.slug() lowercases-then-splits, so camelCase field keys MERGE into a single word: `itchNight` → `hist-itchnight`, `sensoryHands` → `assess-sensoryhands`, `dfaPcr` → `lab-dfapcr`, `priorScabies` → `hist-priorscabies`.
- ChoiceRow/CheckGrid slug DOES NOT trim trailing hyphens, so `Paralysed (2)` → `assess-vmteye-paralysed-2-` (trailing dash). Same for other options ending in punctuation.
- ChoiceRow has NO container testid — only individual options are testable (e.g. `hist-itchnight-yes`, `assess-sensoryhands-both`).
- Section bodies render only when open. Default open state is {1:true}. Clicking `section-toggle-<n>` TOGGLES; if a section is already open, clicking again collapses it and any body-region-* / lesion-code-* selectors inside disappear.
- Body chart is a region grid, not SVG paths: pick lesion code (`lesion-code-<CODE>`) THEN click a region (`body-region-<slug>`). Clicking the same region with the same code active removes the mark.
- Elijah = P-2026-001001, 21kg. His seeded encounter status is 'Draft' (not 'Complete') — patient card shows 'Draft'.
- Admin login lands on /dashboard (not /mis or /patients). Navigate explicitly.
- No route /mis — the MIS Dashboard is served at /dashboard.
- Zero page errors and zero console errors observed in this run.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. All 5 disease flows, all dose calculations, Leprosy MB/PB/No-Leprosy auto-diagnosis, Yaws Primary auto-diagnosis, G2D=2 disability alert, adherence grids, patient card meta, suspect list (31 symptoms + 7 options), admin regiment tab (6 seeded regimens), MIS filter toggle + custom dates + table view, and 390px responsiveness all verified end-to-end. Elijah's card showing 'Draft' rather than 'Complete' is a seed-data choice, not a bug.
